title: MCP server returns 400 or 404 on session id after initialize when it runs on several instances
symptoms: 400 Bad Request on calls after a successful initialize
404 Not Found for an Mcp-Session-Id after a deploy or restart
Works locally on one process, fails behind a load balancer or on serverless
cause: In protocol versions 2025-03-26 to 2025-11-25, a stateful server keeps the session in process memory, so a request routed to another instance has no session. Servers answer a missing id with 400 and an ended one with 404, after which the client must initialize again.
fix: Run the server stateless (no session id generator), pin sessions to an instance, or keep session state in a shared store. The 2026-07-28 protocol removes sessions and the Mcp-Session-Id header entirely.
apply: new StreamableHTTPServerTransport({ sessionIdGenerator: undefined }) // stateless: any instance can answer
affected: MCP protocol 2025-03-26 through 2025-11-25 servers on multi-instance or serverless hosting; sessions removed in 2026-07-28
